label: Data Query
description: Write, inspect, or explain queries over structured data.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for SQL/query work or data extraction.

label: Data Schema Review
description: Review database, event, API, or analytics schemas.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether a schema is correct, stable, or useful.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to edit frontend UI.

label: Data Transformation
description: Transform, normalize, clean, or map data between shapes.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to convert data formats or clean records.

label: Data Analysis
description: Analyze structured data for patterns, summaries, and conclusions.

classifier.useWhen: User asks what a dataset shows.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for general web research.

label: Data Visualization
description: Plan charts, tables, or visual summaries for data.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to visualize data.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for illustrative creative art.

label: Data Validation
description: Validate data quality, constraints, completeness, and anomalies.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether data is correct or clean.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for schema design only.

label: Data Extraction
description: Extract structured data from text, files, tables, or documents.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to pull fields or records from content.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for narrative summary only.

label: Data Joining
description: Combine datasets, keys, records, or tables into a coherent shape.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to merge or join data.

label: Data Quality Audit
description: Audit quality, lineage, anomalies, duplication, and fitness for use.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for data quality review.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for security audit only.

label: Metric Definition
description: Define metrics, dimensions, calculations, and caveats.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to define a metric or analytics logic.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for business strategy only.
